text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on a well earned first place, Almond Eye.
You "Umamusume" really are fast, huh.
I had some confidence in my own speed, but you've beaten me fair and square.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一着おめでとう、
アーモンドアイ。
ウマ娘ってのは
本当に速いんだね。
多少は脚に自信があったけど、
完敗だよ。

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
I'm glad I got the result I was aiming for.
But... when I think that THAT had something to do with my time today...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう！　
結果が出せてうれしいわ。
でも……
今日の時計には
アレが絡んでたって思うと……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no need to say any more. You're talking about THAT, aren't you?
When I heard the name "Geo Niflhell", I knew what to expect...
But, well... I've just never been able to handle that sort of thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
皆まで
お言いでないよ。
アレだろ、
アレ。
ジオ・ニヴルヘル、
って聞いて
覚悟はしてたのさ。
けど、
ねえ……
やっぱり
アレは苦手だよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You never know what they really are, you can't even cut them down with a blade, and worst of all, they go out of their way to scare people...
text_block_list.orig_text:
得体は知れないし、
刀じゃ切れないし。
何より、
わざわざ人のことを脅かそうってのが──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAAAAAAAAAAH?!
W-W-W-What was that slimy, shivering, cold thing just now!?
C-C-Could it be a... G-G-GHOST!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃあああああ！？
ななななんだい、
今の
ヌルッとしてブルッとして冷たいのはっ！？
ま
ま
ま、
まさか、
幽霊っ！？

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ruka-san!
It's just konjac! Just plain old konjac★
...Oh. She's already run off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やだ、
ルカさん。
こんにゃくですよ、
こんにゃく★
って。
行っちゃいましたけど……

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ruka-san's amazing...!
She's even faster than before!
Hehehe. Maybe I should go for another run, too. I've still got plenty of running left in me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカさんすごい……！　
さっきより速くなってる！
ふふふっ、
わたしも走ろうかしら、
まだまだ走り足りないもの！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ghosts are scary, but konjac is just fine!
Plus, it's delicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊は怖いけど、
こんにゃくなら大丈夫よ！
おいしいしっ──！

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text:
Oh my my...
Whatever shall I do with this konjac now, I wonder.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら。
このこんにゃく、
どうしましょう。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, girlie... looks like you've got something nice.
Why don't you hand it over to me?
All so we can set up a "good thing", don'tcha think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉ姉ちゃん……
イイもん持ってんじゃねぇか。
そいつを
アタシにくれないか？
イイコト、
しようぜ？

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text:
Geez...
Even when you're not a Shadow, Gold Ship-san, you're always trying to get your hands on something, aren't you~?
So, what's this "good thing" you have in mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー
ゴルシさんはシャドウじゃなくても、
ほしがりさんですね～
で、
イイコトって、
なんです？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious!
An oden party!
And, of course, the menu's gonna be nothing but ganmodoki (fried tofu)!
text_block_list.orig_text:
決まってらぁ！　
おでんパーティーよ。
もちろん、
がんもどき
オンリーの……
な。

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text:
You can have that all to yourself, Gold Ship-san!
Be my guest♪
I'll be having ramen with Ai-san and the others...★
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはゴルシさんオンリーで、
どうぞどうぞ♪
わたしはアイさんたちと、
ラーメンをいただきますので……★
